title: Making Small Commits
objective: Make two commits, one per file, then print the subjects and the number of commits.
prerequisites: Writing a Message With a Body
hint: Commit README.md alone with git add README.md and git commit -q -m "Add practice notes". Then LICENSE.md alone, with its own commit. Then Write-Output (git log --format=%s), and Commits: with $(git rev-list --count HEAD).
